context:
Goal: every merged PR carries a review record the merge tool really posted and read back.
Problem (rule): `merge --review-record` printed "nothing was posted" for #3226 (head 29e2b9461) and for #3192 and others, so their lanes hand-posted the exact lines the tool printed, through the GitHub tool with the footer (#3226: comment 6863843498, 14:18 CST, read back at that head). The coordinator and batch runner 10 agreed this as a stopgap. You have not ruled on hand-posting. The cure is PR #3235 (record read-back fix), which the runner puts in the earliest batch. A second sighting: under `verdict` the tool's "nothing was posted" line is hidden and only PASS shows; the log has it (lane mutate-sweep-control, #3226).
Based on (read): the coordinator's and runner 10's messages, 14:18 and 14:42 CST Nov 13; triage has read neither the comments nor #3235.
Departs from: main — the tool posts the record; this lets a lane post the tool's printed lines by hand until #3235 lands.
Meanwhile: lanes keep hand-posting under the stopgap; nothing typed, only the tool's printed lines.

options.gain: Lanes keep moving; the record text is the tool's own.
options.label: Allow the stopgap until #3235 lands: a lane hand-posts only the exact lines the tool printed, with the footer (Recommended)
options.lose: A record exists that the tool did not post, and a read-back may not catch a mistyped line.

options.gain: Every record is the tool's own post.
options.label: No hand-posting: a record counts only when the tool posts it
options.lose: Affected lanes (#3226, #3192, others) wait for #3235 to merge.

owner: coordinator (session_013NEJL1gw6EdrSyvHkTUEx6) and batch runner 10 (session_013NEJL2f1YCYsvLdpFqtWP3); posted by triage (session_013NEJKzCzoWhfP8FMCPtQU6)
reply: Filed: ruling own-762-a-hand-post-stopgap (roadmap e5bfe7919). A lane may hand-post the exact lines the tool printed, with the footer, until PR #3235 lands.
short: Hand-post the review record until #3235 lands?
title: May a lane hand-post the review record the tool printed but did not post, until PR #3235 lands?
why: The stopgap is already in use on #3226 and #3192; it departs from the tool posting the record, and you have not ruled on it.
